auth_details: API key via 17token header (self-serve signup on api.17track.net)
free_tier_limits: As of 2026-01-07, new accounts get a one-time free allocation of 200 tracking numbers (monthly free quota ended); paid plans by volume thereafter.
paid_plans: Paid plans by tracking volume; see official pricing
rate_limits: 3 requests/second (HTTP 429 when exceeded); max 40 tracking numbers per request; ~400,000 registrations/hour.
description: 17TRACK provides a multi-carrier package tracking API that aggregates shipment status across hundreds of global postal and express carriers. Developers register numbers, receive tracking events, and get delivery updates for international e-commerce and logistics workflows.
